mapper.insert: insert into class(name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject, create_time, update_time) values (#{name},#{room},#{beginDate},#{endDate},#{masterId},#{subject},#{createTime},#{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id,name,room,begin_date,end_date,master_id,create_time,update_time, case when begin_date < localtimestamp and localtimestamp < end_date then '已开班' when begin_date > localtimestamp then '未开班' when localtimestamp > end_date then '已结课' end status from class

select id,name,room,begin_date,end_date,master_id,create_time,update_time, case when begin_date < localtimestamp and end_date > localtimestamp then '已开班' when begin_date > localtimestamp then '未开班' when localtimestamp > end_date then '已结课' end status from class where id=#{id}
